deficiencies.description: The rewrite links the slice through a tumour to the previous statement by claiming it 'illustrates this' (i.e. explanting the tumour), whereas the text merely mentions explanting tumours and then describes what is shown on the slide without linking the two as an illustration.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So the other thing to appreciate is that when, if you like, biologists are studying tumors, often they will explant the tumor. Here you're looking at a slice through a tumor and a stain to look at the morphology.
